purpose: Teach: 歳月/安打/口実/地検/回生/町並み/孔/陵

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、長い歳月の未解決事件を、警察、再捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police will be reopening this long-unsolved case, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. Posture of genuine inquiry — not challenging. A slight pause before the tag question, giving weight to the observation. Soft, curious inflection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、野球賭博での安打操作も捜査されますね
lines.en: And they'll also be investigating the gambling and point-shaving involved, correct?
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Collaborative rather than defensive. Clean articulation. Nods slightly on the affirmation — acknowledging scope without elaborating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の口実供述を、警察、厳しく追及されますね
lines.en: The police will be pressing hard on the suspect's testimony and inconsistencies, then?
lines.style: Serious, slightly tighter tempo. Leans forward minutely on 'pressing.' Careful diction — respecting the gravity of interrogation without dramatizing. Quiet intensity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地検と連携して立件されますね
lines.en: Right. We're coordinating with the prosecutor's office to build the case.
lines.style: Confirms with understated authority. Brief, efficient phrasing. Speaks like someone who has said this before. Matter-of-fact but not cold — just doing the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、若手警官の回生プログラムを、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: So there's also a mentorship program for younger officers being implemented as part of this?
lines.style: Inquisitive but not skeptical. Recognition of the broader human dimension. Pauses slightly on 'mentorship' — genuine interest in the answer. Warm undertone beneath the formal phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、町並み保存地区での治安維持もされますね
lines.en: We handle security in the historic preservation districts too, of course.
lines.style: Expansive, matter-of-fact. A hint of quiet pride in scope of work. Unhurried delivery — speaking from the vantage of someone who sees the full picture. Light and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人の弾痕、つまり弾の孔を鑑識されますね
lines.en: The forensics will examine the bullet hole at the scene, I assume?
lines.style: Precise, clinical register. Slight formality in word choice. Measured delivery — treating the technical detail with appropriate weight. Lean forward slightly on 'forensics.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、皇族陵墓の警備も担当されますね
lines.en: We're also responsible for security at imperial mausoleums, naturally.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, with understated gravity. Acknowledges sacred responsibility without overselling it. Calm, steady rhythm. A touch of formal deference in the phrasing.
